job_post_list.title: TikTok Shop - GTL Logistics - Project Engineer- Indonesia
job_post_list.description:
Team Introduction
Project team is responsible for coordinating and managing technical projects to ensure they are completed on time, within budget, and in accordance with all technical specifications and quality standards. The role involves working closely with internal teams, clients, and suppliers to ensure the successful delivery of projects.

Responsibilities
- Handle all fit-outs and/or renovation projects
- Collect all information from stakeholders and conduct data reviews for design analysis
- Prepare design layouts, timeline and budget calculation
- Monitor renovation works conducted
job_post_list.requirement:
Minimum Qualifications: 
 - Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, or related field).
- Proven experience as a Project Engineer or in a similar engineering project management role.
- Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera).
- Familiarity with industry standards and safety regulations.
- Proficiency in technical software related to the engineering field such as AutoCAD
- Able to communicate in english well

Preferred Qualifications:
- Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving
